blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `createCustomerAddresses` method. This belongs to the Customer Module.
You should only use this methods when implementing complex customizations. For common cases, check out [available workflows instead](/medusa-workflows-reference).
This method adds addresses to customers.

```ts
const addresses = await customerModuleService.createCustomerAddresses([
  {
    customer_id: "cus_123",
    address_name: "Home",
    address_1: "432 Stierlin Rd",
    city: "Mountain View",
    country_code: "us",
  },
])
```

})
